title: CBIC Clarifies 10% Concessional Customs Duty for Battery Energy Storage Systems; Industrial & Grid-Scale Batteries Not "Power Banks"
content:
# CBIC Clarifies 10% Concessional Customs Duty for Battery Energy Storage Systems; Industrial & Grid-Scale Batteries Not "Power Banks"

Ek important update hai! Government ne Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) par customs duty ke applicability ko lekar ek crucial clarification announce kiya hai. This will bring much-needed clarity for the energy storage industry.

The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) has issued **Circular No. 45/2026-Customs dated October 9, 2026**, addressing the concessional customs duty for BESS.

Here are the key takeaways:

*   The CBIC has clarified that a **10% concessional Basic Customs Duty (BCD)** rate is applicable to Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) falling under tariff item 8507 60 00.
*   Crucially, stationary, grid-scale, and industrial lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) are **not to be treated as "Power Banks"** for the purpose of exclusion from this concessional duty benefit.
*   The term "Power Bank" under Serial No. 325 of Table I of Notification No. 45/2025-Customs (and corresponding earlier notifications) refers specifically to lithium-ion battery devices with charging/discharging ports designed for external charging of mobile phones or portable electronic devices.
*   This clarification aims to remove ambiguity and ensure uniform assessment practices by customs field formations, preventing the denial of concessional duty benefits to eligible energy storage systems.
